scope: Longer computer interaction samples; text-guided observation only.

patterns.finding: Can yield varied activity over a long take, but exact beat timing is not reliable.
Laptop trackpad language triggered high curls and crossed hands in Kling and Wan. Simplified keyboard-only prompt reduced crossing, but later hovering persisted.
Choose an uninterrupted 9-second laptop range with several behaviors; do not hide failure by looping a short static moment. Longer 15-second source retained for inspection.
All rejected laptop takes had stable, believable faces. That did not establish usable device interaction.
